description: This Java source file defines an immutable data object 'LoanTransactionData' that represents a loan transaction within the Apache Fineract project. It includes various fields related to loan transactions such as IDs, amounts, dates, types, and related options, as well as static factory methods for creating specific instances of loan transactions for import and templating purposes.
